set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: O03.2
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend/operations engineer with institutional operator
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Implement the recoverable authority stream without treating ordinary outbox delivery as a durability guarantee.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O03 (bd-01M4W40KBWB13MJQHFAGJEGYZR)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Capture agreed authority transitions with monotonic identity, attributable intent and idempotent replication to the configured independent store.
2. Enforce the specified acknowledgment/fail-closed behavior under journal outage and recover in-flight changes without accepting stale checkpoints.
3. Retain verified checkpoints and replay membership, stewardship, disablement and expiring grants; protect journal data and expose replication lag without secrets.

Verification: Fault injection before/after each local/remote durability boundary, reordered/duplicate events, missing suffixes and tampered-checkpoint tests.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O03.2/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

Starting code/evidence:
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresRecovery.scala
- scripts/backup-postgres.sh
- scripts/restore-postgres.sh

Blocked by:
- O03.1: bd-01M4W5P9194RGNP7DFGHB7ZK09
- F03.2: bd-01M4W5P5GCCHC6ZMZ7MCGEJCW8
- F04.3: bd-01M4W5P64ZQD531177ZZKYVC4K

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
